HdmaGradientBuildV1: Gradient builder (variant 1) — build diamond brightness pattern in WRAM buffer
HdmaGradientBuildV2: Gradient builder (variant 2) — same diamond pattern but for thinker_def_05FB32
HdmaSegmentSplitDown: HDMA segment splitter (downward) — splits extent into max-127 scanline segments
HdmaSegmentSplitUp: HDMA segment splitter (upward) — same as HdmaSegmentSplitDown but sets bit 7 for direction
HdmaParamChangeCheck:
Parameter change detection + double buffer toggle
Compares $FE/$FC, $F6/$F4, $FA/$F8 — if all match, returns carry set (no change).
On change: copies new params to previous, toggles chatPtr for double buffering,
and sets up the write pointer for the appropriate buffer half.
HdmaNoChange: Return carry set — no parameter change detected
HdmaInitPrevState: Initialize previous-state registers to zero (called on thinker's first frame)
HdmaCompareParams:
Compare current vs previous gradient parameters
Returns: carry set = no change, carry clear = changed
HdmaCopyCurrentToPrev: Copy current gradient parameters to previous-state registers
